title: Vanity Top Soap Dispenser Solid Brass 5 Oz | Matte White | Brass & Glass Soap Dispensers | Allied Brass
short_title: Vanity Top Soap Dispenser 5 Oz, Matte White
description:
Keep soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer right where you need it with a vanity top soap dispenser that keeps your bathroom counter looking pulled together in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. Designed with a distinctive, transitional look, it coordinates easily with other versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Refill less often with a generous 5 ounce bottle capacity
- Count on enduring construction with solid brass materials
- Coordinate your space with the Brass & Glass Soap Dispensers collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Details:
- Product type: Vanity top soap dispenser (for soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer)
- Capacity: 5 oz
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in x 7 in x 5 in
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
